'''Underwater propellers''' were a type of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] locomotion system. Due to the ease with which [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droids]] were able to be upgraded and adjusted, some units were known to have been modified with underwater propellers.<ref name="EGTD" />
